event.name: NFC Summit 2026
event.summary: Three-day digital arts conference focused on NFTs, generative art, and Web3 culture. Attendees include artists, collectors, curators, and Web3-native professionals.

sideEvents.name: MOODSCAPE: An RnA Studio Interactive Playground
sideEvents.venue: Fábrica da Moagem (basement), Unicorn Factory Lisboa — Beato Innovation District
sideEvents.description: Three-day immersive environment at the intersection of machine intelligence, physical architecture, and human presence. Features AI-powered installations, acoustic sculptures, and generative visual art. Includes Searching For (satellite imagery diffusion model), Ganchitecture (interactive LED sculpture), Balëine/Whalesong (AI oceanographic art), a VR experience, and the 204.ai Interactive Playground with Magic Mirror, AI Photobooth, and Glitch Synth.

sideEvents.name: Not just JPEGS | Brunch by Mr Richi
sideEvents.description: Exclusive art brunch for creators, collectors, and Web3 art scene builders. Great food, real conversations, and art you feel. Includes brunch networking, a physical art segment, and off-stage discussions. Attendance requires host approval and wallet token verification. Powered by Basileus.

sideEvents.name: Claude Code Meetup | June Edition
sideEvents.description: Special edition bringing Claude For Everyone to Lisbon during NFC Summit. Practical sessions on integrating Claude into everyday work — content, research, automation, and creative applications — followed by networking and a guided tour of the NFC Summit exhibition. Welcomes both developers and non-technical participants.

sideEvents.name: OpenClaw + Hermes Agent Lisbon Meetup | June Edition
sideEvents.description: OpenClaw lands in Lisbon for a special edition — right in the heart of NFC Summit. Two-hour gathering featuring talks and workshops on AI agents and open infrastructure, followed by networking and guided exhibition tours of the NFC Summit showcase.

sideEvents.name: MeWe: The Death of the Like + Drinks with Mewe!
sideEvents.description: MeWe CEO Carlos Betancourt presents the thesis that the Like button is dead and proposes a Social Economy where crypto transfers replace passive approval as proof of genuine engagement. After the talk, join the speaker on stage for refreshments and open discussion.

sideEvents.name: Arab Bank Switzerland: Collecting, Institutions & Emerging Digital Artists
sideEvents.organiser: NFC SUMMIT (presented by Arab Bank Switzerland)
sideEvents.description: Five voices from art and technology discuss how financial institutions can support emerging digital creators. Topics: patron-artist relationships, digital art collection, and bridging conventional finance with the Web3 art world. Panelists include Abigail Miller (moderator), Nina Roehrs, Gretchen Andrew, Jonas Lund, and Cezar Mocan.

sideEvents.name: Get Started with AI Agents: A Practical Afternoon
sideEvents.description: Hands-on workshop introducing AI agents — no experience required. Drop by anytime in the afternoon with your laptop. The PyratzLabs team walks you through the fundamentals. Two sessions (Session 1 and Session 2) running simultaneously; both are open-door with drop-in format.

sideEvents.name: VIBE-A-THON [CoLab x NFC Summit]
sideEvents.description: 24-hour AI-focused build event for builders, founders, developers, artists, and complete beginners. Two tracks: Creative AI (visual and generative outputs) and Productivity/Agents (practical problem-solving tools). No gatekeeping — competitive or casual, solo or team. Mentors, jury panel, and prizes for standout projects. Note: NFC Agent (normieagent.com) is one of the co-hosts of this event.

sideEvents.name: NOT A CULT PARTY — NFC 2026
sideEvents.description: Outdoor gathering at Unicorn Factory Lisbon with semi-live music, pre-recorded DJ sets, visual art on screen, and drinks in a relaxed outdoor atmosphere. Dance or just sip something cold and vibe. Entry requires an NFC Summit 2026 ticket.

sideEvents.name: Introduction Stablecoin Day + Zama
sideEvents.description: Opening keynote of Stablecoin Day. Bilal El Alamy from Zama discusses what's coming next for digital finance and why confidential computing matters. Zama specialises in Fully Homomorphic Encryption enabling blockchains to process encrypted data — with applications for compliant stablecoins, private balances, and on-chain confidentiality.

sideEvents.name: Crypto Stamps — When Postal Heritage Meets Web3
sideEvents.description: Morning session exploring the convergence of traditional philately and blockchain technology. Presentations from Austrian Post, La Poste France, and the Universal Postal Union, alongside collectors. Topics: blockchain-based collectible stamps, digital collecting formats reshaping cultural heritage, and community engagement in Web3.

sideEvents.name: Day 2 | 100 Collectors Art Tour at NFC
sideEvents.description: Guided walkthrough of the NFC Summit art programme from the collector's perspective. Moves through selected artworks with emphasis on discovery, context, and conversation. Tailored for collectors and those curious about digital art. Requires a valid NFC Summit ticket.

sideEvents.name: Meebits Fútbol Fiesta Brunch (partnership with OpenSea)
sideEvents.description: Casual brunch gathering Meebits ecosystem holders and friends to celebrate Meebits Fútbol, soccer, and the community's 5th anniversary. Complimentary food and soft drinks. Limited capacity — registration and wallet verification required. Open to Meebits ecosystem holders and invited guests.

sideEvents.name: Stablecoin Day
sideEvents.description: Dedicated day bringing together banks, financial institutions, fintech, and crypto stakeholders to examine stablecoins' impact on payments, treasury management, and financial flows. Panels on bank adoption, cross-border transactions, MiCA regulatory frameworks, institutional strategies, and real-world implementations. Includes opening keynote and lunch networking session.

sideEvents.name: XRPL Meetup, Lisbon
sideEvents.description: Curated gathering for blockchain developers and founders in fintech, DeFi, tokenization, and Web3. Official side event of NFC Lisbon. Features presentations on building with XRPL, the XRPL Commons Aquarium Incubator programme, and networking. Accepted participants also receive NFC Summit access. Limited spots.
sideEvents.ticketType: approval + wallet verification; includes NFC Summit access

sideEvents.name: AI Slop Party: An Afternoon of Synthetic Regret
sideEvents.description: Come poke at AI, make beautiful garbage, generate questionable things, remix nonsense, have a drink, and generally help the machines embarrass themselves. Prompts, play, strange outputs, low-stakes chaos, interesting people, and a few surprises.

sideEvents.name: Preserving Cryptoart in the Post-Platform Era — A DRL Working Session
sideEvents.venue: Community Lounge, Art Factory Rare Art Floor — Level 1 (AF-110)
sideEvents.description: Collaborative working session examining challenges in cryptoart preservation. Using Async Art as a case study, participants (artists, collectors, archivists, curators) assess what breaks, what can be recovered, and how the cryptoart community can preserve what still exists. Aims to develop shared practices to prevent future losses.

sideEvents.name: Reset Protocol: Reset & Recharge — Practical Tools for Energy and Focus
sideEvents.description: Wellness session addressing nervous system regulation during an intensive summit. Nataliia Kolesnykova (energy and nervous system specialist) offers science-backed tools to regulate your nervous system, reset energy, and return to peak state. Interactive with movement, breathing exercises, and practical techniques you can apply immediately.

notes: Side event list sourced from luma.com/nfcsummit on 2026-05-28. Dates marked 'unknown' have been estimated from context. The Normies community brunch on June 6th is not yet listed — add when URL is confirmed. Check luma.com/nfcsummit for the latest additions.
